description: This file defines an administrative controller class 'WeightClass' within the OpenCart framework, responsible for managing weight classes in the localisation module. It includes methods for listing, creating, editing, and deleting weight classes, with proper authorization checks, data validation, and view rendering.

classes.name: WeightClass
classes.description: Controller class managing weight classes in the admin localisation section of OpenCart, providing CRUD operations and listing functionalities.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the default page load; prepares data for listing weight classes including sorting and pagination, and renders the list view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a list of weight classes in a view, typically for AJAX or partial page updates.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML view with the list of weight classes, including sorting, pagination, and action links.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing a weight class, pre-filling data if editing an existing one.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes form submission to add or update a weight class; performs permission checks, data validation, and saves data via the model.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected weight classes, checking permissions, and updating the list accordingly.
